article.title: The Third Schedule
article.html:
ThirdThe Third Schedule

[THE THIRD SCHEDULE.] Omitted by the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 (10 of 2009), s. 50 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).

Note: this Schedule had carried the amendments to the Banker's Books Evidence Act, 1891 made by section 93.
